info.title: Locus messages
info.description: Direct messages between ships. Each ship keeps its own copy; a sent message is pending until the peer acks it.

get.summary: One row per peer: count, unread, and the last message
All messages with one peer, oldest first

post.summary: Mark messages from this peer as read, through the newest
Refuse incoming messages from this peer (our sends still go)
Accept incoming messages from this peer again
Send: body {to, body}; returns the new message id

delete.summary: Delete this ship's copy of a message (the peer keeps theirs)

blocked.description: Incoming messages from this peer are refused
